title: Understanding Confidence Intervals
text: A confidence interval gives a range of values that is likely to contain the true parameter value. If a confidence interval for a parameter includes $$0$$, it suggests that $$0$$ is a plausible value for that parameter, but it doesn't confirm it as the true value.

title: Bootstrap Sampling
text: Bootstrap sampling involves repeatedly drawing samples from a dataset with replacement. This method helps estimate the distribution of a statistic, such as a parameter estimate, by simulating many possible samples.

title: Interpreting the Confidence Interval
text: If the 95% confidence interval of a parameter estimate includes $$0$$, what does it imply about the null hypothesis that the parameter is 0?
